svg.metadata: {"title": "Sensor reading", "description": "A reading, big: a name, its value and unit, an icon, when.", "fields": {"name": {"default": "Temperature"}, "value": {"default": "21.5"}, "unit": {"default": "°C"}, "icon": {"default": "mdi:thermometer"}, "when": {"default": "{{datetime}}", "help": "under the value"}}, "example": {"name": "Living room", "value": "21.5", "unit": "°C", "icon": "mdi:thermometer"}}
